ideas.title: Minnesota Food Stamp Funding Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the fraud scandal surrounding Minnesota's food stamp funding and the subsequent freeze by the USDA.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud and who was involved.
questions: Who was involved in the fraud?
What actions were taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant case of fraud and potentially lead to further investigations and accountability.

ideas.title: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the DOJ investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell and its implications for the central bank's independence.
ideas.angle: Examine the potential impact on the economy and the Federal Reserve's role.
questions: What are the allegations against Powell?
How will this investigation affect the Federal Reserve?
What are the potential economic implications?
ideas.insight: This story could have significant implications for the economy and the Federal Reserve's role, making it a high-priority investigation.
